name: m4-hk-fastpath-typer-kperf-2
description: Does binding the kind check in `TypeComparers.isSubType2` (`tp1.isHigherKinded || tp2.isHigherKinded`) and `TypeRef.relativize` remove their vtable stubs, and what does it buy on a typer-only compile of the scala corpus? In `m4-symfinal-typer-kperf`'s base profile, `NoArgsTypeRef.isHigherKinded` is 0.50% of cycles inclusive, 0.32% of it under `isSubType2`. Rerun of `m4-hk-fastpath-typer-kperf` on `2.13.x` after [scala/scala#11365](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11365), which takes `Global` from 70 secondary supers to 52; on the old base, `lookup_secondary_supers_table_slow_path_stub` took 3% of cycles from `invokespecial` of private trait methods.
One fork per build and round, kperf cycles and instructions, JIT recorded over each whole fork for `jit_diff`. Patched JDK 26, `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`.

variantDescriptions.hk: `pr208` plus `65fe452a34`: final `TypeRef.isHigherKinded` with `NoArgsTypeRef.typeParams` inlined, a `TypeRef` type test before `isHigherKinded` in `isSubType2`, and `PolyType`/`ClassInfoType` cases before `rawInfo.typeParams` in `Symbol.typeParams`
